checkpoint_rule: Every chunk is independently checkpointed, immutable and verified before merge. Resume computes only missing verified chunks.
chunk_outputs: child record keyed by child SHA

deterministic_partition.chunk_id: zero-padded ordinal plus first/last parent SHA
deterministic_partition.chunking: contiguous parent SHA ranges of generation_chunk_parent_count frozen in the chain plan

reference_gate: Chunked L16 recomputation must be byte-identical in scientific projection to the certified v0.18.3 monolithic L16 forward result before implementation graduates.
semantics: Exactly one complete lawful primitive-attachment step from every certified parent object to every chain-pinned primitive record and every legal selected-port pair.
